title: Ruthless Grape Drank On Ice Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Grape Drank On Ice by Ruthless delivers the same bold, candy-like taste of the original, now with an added icy twist. The rich, syrupy sweetness of Grape meets the effervescent fizz of classic Grape Soda, creating a smooth yet punchy vape. A crisp menthol finish rounds out the flavour, adding a refreshing coolness that enhances the lively fruit and soda notes without overpowering them. One of many incredible flavours found in the celebrated Ruthless Shortfill collection, Grape Drank On Ice features a 70VG/30PG ratio for dense vapour production and a smooth, well-balanced inhale. Designed for Sub-Ohm vape kits and advanced DTL (direct-to-lung) devices, it comes in a 100ml shortfill bottle with space for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing for a customisable nicotine strength. Ruthless has been shaping the e-liquid industry for years, crafting bold and innovative blends that push the boundaries of flavour. Their commitment to high-quality ingredients and expert craftsmanship ensures a standout vaping experience in every bottle.
